trigger: phase in Founding,Expansion & kingdom.fed_ratio < 0.8 & citizen.hunger >= 0.3 & citizen.has_family
thought_text: Bowls are empty at home again...
question_text: Ruler, we fill the storehouse, yet my own children go to bed hungry. Will you open the grain store to the farmers' families?
notes: DRAFT: VS-1. Compassion vs authority vs fear; costs food.

thought_text: Another one? My back is a knot of rope.
question_text: We've raised one building after another without a pause, ruler. The crew is dropping hammers. Can we rest, or at least eat something hot?
notes: DRAFT: VS-1. Rest vs food vs push on.

thought_text: Porridge again? Some army this is.
question_text: We took your colours this morning, ruler, and supper was thin porridge. Will the crown feed its soldiers like soldiers?
notes: DRAFT: VS-1, after recruiting. The promise option leads to soldier_pay_due.

thought_text: Logs piled high, and my hearth is cold.
question_text: The yard is stacked with timber we cut, ruler, yet our own hearths are cold at night. May we take a few logs home?
notes: DRAFT: VS-1. Needs a wood surplus.

thought_text: The east face creaks at night...
question_text: The rock in the east face groans like an old door, ruler. I'm afraid it will come down on us. Could we prop it up with timber?
notes: DRAFT: VS-1, timid miners only. Shoring up ends it for good.

thought_text: That cart-thief is at it again.
question_text: {rival} keeps taking my handcart and boasting that my loads are theirs. Will you settle this, ruler, before I settle it myself?

thought_text: These forge walls won't last the month.
question_text: The forge walls are cracking from the heat, ruler. Forty stone would make them sound, and every blade I make. Can the crown spare it?
notes: DRAFT: VS-2 key citizen petition (crown-arena.md section 4).

thought_text: These recruits can't hold a line yet.
question_text: The recruits trip over their own spears, ruler, and their spirits are sinking. How do we turn them into soldiers?
notes: DRAFT: VS-2 key citizen petition (drill the recruits).

thought_text: Full granary, long faces. A feast?
question_text: The granary is full, ruler, but spirits are low. A feast at the keep would lift every heart. Shall I light the ovens?
notes: DRAFT: VS-2 key citizen petition (hold a feast).

thought_text: They whisper the ruler's name in fear.
question_text: The young ones whisper your name like a storm warning, ruler. Fear raises walls fast, but it rots the beams. Will you hear them?
notes: DRAFT: VS-2. Reacts to the ruler's fear reputation.

thought_text: The east field is golden. Our sacks?
question_text: The east field came in heavy, ruler. You promised its first sacks to my family. Do you remember?
notes: DRAFT: follow-up to grain_promise_harvest. Delaying makes the farmer ask again.

thought_text: The tower is ours. Where's our gold?
question_text: The watchtower flies our colours, ruler, and you promised us gold when it fell. The squad is waiting.
